product: Field Notes Original Kraft 89 x 140 memo-book station

scope.intended_use: Register one closed Field Notes Original Kraft memo book against two loose, non-clamping desk datums for repeatable adult indoor writing or display placement.
scope.user_context: Adult use on a dry, flat indoor desk or shelf; digital-first product planning with physical fit and stability qualification required before an offer.
variants: Field Notes Original Kraft memo book with published 89 x 140 mm planform
left- or right-spine orientation remains a requirements parameter using the same named planform
out_of_scope: Other Field Notes editions or unnamed notebooks
Thickness-controlled capture or clamping the stapled spine
Archival, impact-protection, security, child-use, wall-use, or vehicle-use claims
Commercial release before rights, trademark, market, compliance, physical and human approval gates close

entities.name: One current Field Notes Original Kraft memo book
Dry flat indoor desk or shelf
Adult user inserting and removing the book
Pinned Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG Black FFF research baseline

interfaces.name: Named memo-book planform to two loose station datums

coordinate_frame.origin: intersection of the two planned loose datum contact lines on the station base
coordinate_frame.x_positive: across the closed book's published 89 mm planform dimension
coordinate_frame.y_positive: along the closed book's published 140 mm planform dimension
coordinate_frame.z_positive: up from the station's planned desk-support plane

datums.description: planned loose side datum; left/right spine orientation remains a requirements parameter

allowed: clearance motion away from both loose datums
constrained: negative-x translation at datum A during use
negative-y translation at datum B during use

assembly.direction: from above without flexing or clamping the book
assembly.sequence_notes: Keep the top and spine side open; do not use thickness as a fit interface.

keepouts_and_access: Do not clamp or load the stapled spine.
Keep the top and removal path open.
Provide finger access without relying on an unverified book thickness.

evidence.uncertainty_note: The named variant and published planform are identified, but no independent measurement or physical fit exists; cover bow, wear and edition changes remain test variables.

failure_modes.mode: The physical book binds, rocks, or is marked at a datum.
failure_modes.effect: The station fails its placement function or cosmetically marks a low-value host item.
failure_modes.mitigation: Derive clearance only after a two-datum coupon and 20-cycle physical fit/marking test on one current book.

acceptance_criteria: All source-defined datum features on the coupon measure within 0.30 mm of their specified values.
One current Original Kraft book inserts and removes without force.
No visible mark appears after 20 insertion/removal cycles.

interfaces.name: Station support and upright stability on a flat desk

assembly.direction: place the station on its flat stable base
assembly.sequence_notes: Use only on a dry, flat indoor desk or shelf.

loads_and_performance.host_load: one closed memo book; exact physical mass not recorded
loads_and_performance.stability_test: 10-degree base tilt after inserting the book

environment_and_variation.surface: dry, flat indoor desk or shelf
environment_and_variation.friction: UNKNOWN until the physical test surface is recorded

keepouts_and_access: Do not claim wall, vehicle, impact, or security retention.
Do not infer anti-slip performance from geometry alone.

evidence.uncertainty_note: The support context and test are specified, but no station geometry, physical desk surface, mass, center of gravity, or stability result exists.

failure_modes.mode: The station tips or slides during ordinary placement.
failure_modes.effect: The book loses its display position and may receive minor cosmetic damage.
failure_modes.mitigation: Preserve a stable base and verify the complete physical prototype on the recorded surface.

acceptance_criteria: With one current Original Kraft book inserted, the station remains upright after a 10-degree base tilt.

drivers: The 89 x 140 mm named-host planform is a fit-critical interface that still needs an independent measurement and coupon.
The physical station must balance loose fit, non-marking contact and tabletop stability without clamping the spine.
Verification needs a dimensional coupon plus insertion, marking and 10-degree stability tests on one current physical book.

blocking_unknowns: Independent measurement of one current Original Kraft book is not recorded.
Cover bow, corner wear, edition variation and the selected design clearance are not physically characterized.
No coupon, prototype, insertion-cycle, marking or 10-degree stability result exists.
Seller legal identity, source/tool terms evidence, trademark review, outgoing license, DE market/compliance review and commercial approvals remain UNKNOWN/BLOCK.

criticality.rationale: Within the explicitly limited dry adult tabletop scope, credible failures are loss of organization, a reprint, minor book marking, or a low-energy tip; no structural, vehicle, wall, child, archival, security or regulated claim is permitted.
credible_failure_effects: The book binds or cannot be removed comfortably.
A contact datum leaves a visible cosmetic mark.
The station tips or slides and the book loses its display position.

decision.rationale: The exact named planform, limited use, two interfaces, pinned FFF baseline and measurable coupon/prototype tests support parametric fit work. Requirements normalization, concept, clearance selection, coupon and physical fit/stability evidence remain mandatory; this decision does not authorize commercial or physical release.

warnings.message: No independent book measurement, coupon, prototype, marking test or stability result exists.
The digital commercial release remains blocked by UNKNOWN source/tool/trademark/outgoing-license/market approvals even though controlled design work may proceed.

next_actions.action: Normalize and approve revision 0.1.0 requirements, including the left/right spine orientation and loose-clearance strategy, under the current hash-bound autonomy policy.
next_actions.exit_criterion: The requirements stage is approved by its assigned policy authority with no unresolved consequential interface choice.

next_actions.action: Create and approve a concept in a later design phase without treating it as dimensional evidence.
next_actions.exit_criterion: The concept maps visible features to the approved requirements and its assigned approval gate passes.

next_actions.action: Print the two-datum corner coupon and test one current Original Kraft book on the pinned process baseline.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Datum measurements are within 0.30 mm; insertion/removal is force-free; the book remains upright after a 10-degree base tilt; and no visible mark appears after 20 cycles.

next_actions.action: Complete source/tool/trademark/outgoing-license/DE-market reviews and authorized commercial approvals.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Every applicable commercial-clearance gate is evidenced and no BLOCK remains for release MM-ORG-040-0.1.0.
